structuredContent.body:
## Why

The temporal-core comparison needs one inspectable protocol explaining what is held equal, what learns, what costs are charged, and what a successful run does and does not establish.

## Changes

Add the 251-line executable protocol for the shared frozen frontend/head and common learned identity adapter, seven temporal cores, diagnostic reset, microbatching, exact source and checkpoint retention, actual dispatch-dependent budgets, and the separately declared C1 continuation.

The protocol discloses the adapter's effective classifier capacity, the CPU FP64 scope, the analytic event-gradient reference's limits, finite HCSN evidence versus full training-domain qualification, and all failed tuning opportunities.

## Validation

The protocol's relative links are included in the passing three-manifest/four-document evidence check. The repository formatter completed through its existing cached entry, and the protocol, CURRENT and frozen manifest retained their exact hashes. This change adds documentation only; recorded runtime sources and historical results are unchanged.

Stacked on #5829. Entire local and remote tree: `81b57328dcbb9fcf33c93fe0b7a807a66e616c79`.
